film.title: Saw II
S: for the puppet on the tricycle, red spirals and all

Heat the oven to 200C and line two trays. Spread the pesto over the pastry sheets and scatter with the parmesan and oregano. Roll each sheet up tightly and chill until firm. Slice into 1.5cm rounds, lay flat on the trays and brush with egg. Bake until puffed and golden. Cool for a few minutes before serving.
cop snacks for a long night watching the monitors

Heat the oven to 200C and line a tray. Halve and seed the jalapeños, wearing gloves. Mix the cream cheese, cheddar, spring onion and paprika and fill the jalapeño halves. Toss the panko with the oil and press on top. Bake until the chillies blister and the crumb is golden. Serve hot with the sour cream.
M: slow, patient and planned down to the last minute

Season the beef with the salt and pepper and brown well in the oil in a heavy pot, then lift out. Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the same pot. Stir in the tomato paste, add the tomatoes, 375ml beef stock, rosemary and bay, return the beef, cover and simmer on low. Shred the beef with two forks in the pot and simmer uncovered until thick. Cook the pappardelle in salted boiling water and toss through the ragu with a splash of the pasta water. Serve with the parmesan.
W: every piece fits, if you follow the rules

Beat the butter, icing sugar and vanilla until pale. Mix in the flour and cornflour to a soft dough. Wrap and chill. Roll out 7mm thick and cut into puzzle pieces with a cutter or a sharp knife and card template. Lay on lined trays and chill again so they hold their shape. Bake at 160C until pale gold. Cool on the trays. Melt the chocolate, dip half of each piece and leave to set.
K: for the long talk across the table at the steel mill

Whip the cream lightly until just thick but still pourable. Warm 4 heatproof glasses with hot water and tip it out. Stir 1 tsp brown sugar into 150ml coffee in each glass and add 40ml whiskey. Pour the cream over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.
film.D: A detective races to save his son, who is locked in a house with a group of strangers and forced to play the Jigsaw killer's game.
film.P: Serve the jalapeño poppers when Detective Matthews and the SWAT team storm the steel mill.

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 2 tbsp of the oil in batches over high heat until browned, seasoning with the salt and pepper.
Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the rest of the oil.
Stir in the tomato paste, add the tomatoes, lentils, soy sauce, 375ml vegetable stock, rosemary, bay and mushrooms, and simmer gently until thick.
Cook the pappardelle in salted boiling water and toss through the ragu with a splash of the pasta water.
Serve with the parmesan.
